desc: Ideal for range time and competition, the A01-C CUSTOM offers a consistent trigger pull with a DA pull weight of 8-8.5 lbs and SA of 3-3.5 lbs, thanks to its pinned hammer and sear. The firearm is equipped with a 3.854" Match-grade bull barrel and CZ Custom low-mount rear sight with a fiber-optic front sight, ensuring accuracy and precision. CZ USA is renowned for its innovation and quality in the firearm industry.
